author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices counting to three, finding G by the three black keys, echoing short patterns and taking turns, using a cosy tea-time song.

classes.title: How many Pollys?
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and count the three Polly lines before tea time.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting how many times the same line comes back

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up one, two, then three fingers for each Polly line. Pretend to sip on 'tea'.
classes.childAction: Show one, two, three fingers for each Polly line.
classes.bridge: Polly, Polly, Polly: three times, then the kettle is ready for tea.

intro.caption: Count the Pollys with me
intro.parentCue: hold up a finger for each Polly line

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting lines that come back, up to three.

classes.title: Tick-tock tea time
classes.goal: Tap a steady beat on any key while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more and no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on every beat, like a ticking clock.
classes.bridge: The beat is the kitchen clock: tick, tock, tick, tock, until tea.

intro.caption: Tick-tock, it's nearly tea time
intro.parentCue: tap your child's knee on every beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Find the kettle's G
classes.goal: Find G inside the group of three black keys and play it with one finger.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the three black keys as a sign to find G

classes.parentPrompt: Touch three black keys together, then guide one finger to the white key after the first one.
classes.childAction: Find three black keys, then press G like a button.
classes.bridge: Three black keys are the kettle's lid; G hides after the first one.

intro.caption: G hides after the first black key
intro.parentCue: count the three black keys together first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding G by the three black keys.

classes.title: Echo Polly
classes.goal: Listen to short patterns of two or three notes and copy them back.

mathTarget.parentLine: Hearing a tiny tune and keeping it in mind to copy

classes.parentPrompt: Play or sing the pattern, pause, then nod to your child: 'Your turn.'
classes.childAction: Listen, then copy the notes the same way.
classes.bridge: Kettle on: three steps up, like steam rising from the spout.

intro.caption: I play first, then you
intro.parentCue: nod to your child for their turn

games.caption: Kettle on: E, F, G
games.parentCue: Say 'up, up, up' as they play

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing short patterns and copying them back.

classes.title: Same steps, one lower
classes.goal: Echo two patterns and hear that the second is the first, one step lower.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same little tune, moved one step lower

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's arm, then do it again starting a little lower.
classes.childAction: Echo three steps up, then the same steps one lower.
classes.bridge: The second Polly line climbs the same stairs, starting one stair down.

intro.caption: Same stairs, one step lower
intro.parentCue: walk your fingers up their arm twice

games.caption: High stairs: E, F, G
games.parentCue: Point to the first key, E

games.caption: Lower stairs: D, E, F
games.parentCue: Same steps, start one key to the left

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting the same pattern, one step lower.

classes.title: You are the kettle G
classes.goal: Wait and play G at the right moments while the grown-up plays the rest.

mathTarget.parentLine: I play my notes, you play yours: we take turns

classes.parentPrompt: Play your notes, then look at your child and nod just before each G.
classes.childAction: Finger ready on G. Play it when it lights up.
classes.bridge: The grown-up fills the kettle; your G is the whistle when it's ready.

intro.caption: You play the kettle's G
intro.parentCue: nod just before each G comes

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: waiting for your turn and playing on time.

classes.title: Two cooks, one kettle
classes.goal: Play the whole song together, sharing one steady beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two players keeping the same steady beat

classes.parentPrompt: Keep the beat going even if a note is missed; smile and nod at each G.
classes.childAction: Play your G in time with your grown-up's beat.
classes.bridge: Two cooks in one kitchen, moving to the same tick-tock.

intro.caption: Two cooks, one kitchen
intro.parentCue: sit close and keep the beat steady

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: sharing one beat and taking turns.

classes.title: Tea party for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy: three Polly lines, then tea time at the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same line three times, then a new line to finish

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the guest; play, then pretend to pour tea, clap and bow.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, then pretend to pour the tea.
classes.bridge: Polly, Polly, Polly, then the last line walks down: tea is ready!

intro.caption: Teddy is coming for tea!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the guest

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a song with three repeats and an ending.
